title: Domain Checkup Report input
description: Paste the domains you want a report for, then click Start. URLs and email addresses are turned into domains. Invalid lines are skipped and not charged. Each valid domain produces one due-diligence row.

domains.title: Domains
domains.description: Required. Domain names (any TLD), website URLs, or email addresses, one per line. Invalid lines are saved to INVALID_INPUTS in the key-value store and are not charged.

lookupRdap.sectionDescription: Leave both options on for a full report. Turning one off makes the run faster but the row will have less detail.
lookupRdap.title: Look up registration details (RDAP)
lookupRdap.description: Query official IANA-listed RDAP registries for creation date, age, registrar and expiry. Lookups are throttled to about 3 requests per second per registry.

fetchLandingPage.title: Inspect landing page (live status, for-sale & price)
fetchLandingPage.description: When the domain resolves, fetch its HTTP/HTTPS landing page to detect live HTTPS, marketplace redirects, parked pages, and a visible asking price.

maxDomains.title: Max domains per run
maxDomains.description: Safety cap on how many valid domains are checked in one run.

concurrency.title: Concurrency
concurrency.description: Parallel DNS and HTTP checks. Registry RDAP queries stay throttled to about 3 per second per registry.
